plan.purpose: Independent longer-window query recheck with an identical-before control to diagnose small adverse query directions
plan.safety: Guarded private mount/PID/net namespace, before/after stock health and owned-directory cleanup per run
plan.memory: Separate actual registration heap diagnostics; proc RSS/HWM remain diagnostic, not PSS or full peak acceptance.
plan.failure_rule: Stop on collection, correctness, identity, health or cleanup failure; retain raw failed window
plan.analysis: Eight independent randomized triplets: before and control are byte-identical baselines. Publish all per-block ratios, ranges and before/control differences. Do not pool or replace the first four-arm results; no equivalence/superiority verdict.
plan.hypothesis: Check recurrence of lookup/prefix CPU, concurrent mean/throughput and tail increases with unchanged runtime/client bytes; repeated baseline quantifies within-block run variation.
plan.retention_rule: Defer runtime retention if a selected own-CPU median exceeds +1% or p99 exceeds +5%, with at least six of eight positive pairs, against BOTH identical baseline labels. These are conservative investigation gates, not significance tests. Report all other adverse changes.
plan.build_control: Same actual /tmp/owrt-core-release/ubusd source root, SDK, toolchain, cwd and release flags as before; previous exact-root reconstruction reproduced before bytes.
plan.client_control: Frozen ca1a912 client and dependencies plus only process CPU clocks; same binary on all four arms. Do not pool R95/R96 measurements.
plan.metric_directions: Lower is better except ops_per_s, which is higher-is-better. Registration ops are complete add/remove cycles.

method: Paired exploratory blocks; full per-run values; no confidence or equivalence claim
scope: ubusd only, private router namespace, 4 lanes; object counts (64,)
